changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Reference_Fields] AS select F.AssetID, ATT.ObjectID as ReferenceItemTypeID, A.ObjectID as ReferenceItemID, T.Name as FieldTypeName, T.FriendlyName as FieldTypeFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue from Field F inner join FieldType T on T.ID = F.FieldTypeID inner join Asset A on A.ID = F.AssetID inner join AssetType ATT on (A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID) where A.[Object] = 'ReferenceItem' and A.State = 1
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Reference_Fields] AS select F.AssetID, ATT.ObjectID as ReferenceItemTypeID, A.ObjectID as ReferenceItemID, T.Name as FieldTypeName, T.FriendlyName as FieldTypeFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue from Field F inner join FieldType T on T.ID = F.FieldTypeID inner join Asset A on (A.Object = F.ObjectType and A.ObjectID = F.ObjectID) inner join AssetType ATT on (A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID) where A.[Object] = 'ReferenceItem' and A.State = 1
